name: Tsunagi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tsunagi town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings and a pointed tail.
history: Municipal flag of Tsunagi, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 1990; the emblem dates from 1 April 1969.

features.role: Tsunagi town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings and a pointed tail
